description: RTS Bus Stops List Fall 2020 is a dataset listed in City of Gainesville open data portal (data.cityofgainesville.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Gainesville. List of RTS Bus Stops and Stop ID numbers. Coverage: Gainesville, Florida. The portal files it under the category Mobility. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: RTS. The portal shows 2021-09-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofgainesville-org-portal.
